pages.title: Combat Mastery
pages.text: To master combat, we need you to craft a few tools to help you along. The $(item)Deep Learner$() will track your progress with different monster types, by telling you how close you are to mastering combat against that specific monster.$(br2)Mastering combat will also give you access to new resources, and powerful rewards.
Mastering combat and reaping the full benefits of the $(item)Deep Learner$() is its own science. You can learn more inside the $(item)Deep Mob Learning$() guide book.

The $(item)Simulation Chamber$() will produce matter from $(item)Polymer Clay$() which you may have started producing to make your conduit cabling.$(br2)It will also train your models and sometimes produce $(item)Pristine Matter$()

The $(item)Simulation Chamber$() will produce matter from $(item)Polymer Clay$() which you may have started producing to make your conduit cabling.$(br2)It will also train your models and sometimes produce $(item)Pristine Matter$()
The $(item)Loot Fabricator$() will turn $(item)Pristine Matter$() into loot. The type of loot depend on the type of $(item)Pristine Matter$().

The $(item)Trial Keystone$() will allow you to train even more efficiently, fighting waves of monsters in an arena style combat format.$(br2)Some $(item)Self Aware$() trials will even give you special rewards.
To progress, you will need to produce a handful of various $(item)Pristine$() types.
